dev.users.bad_username.text: username must be lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens
dev.users.bad_username.note: Error in Settings > Users when adding a user whose username has other characters. The username also becomes part of the user's own address on the bridge.

dev.users.bridge_check_failed.text: could not reach the bridge to check {domain}, so this user was not created - try again in a moment, or uncheck "request bridge access" to create a local-only account: {detail}
dev.users.bridge_check_failed.note: Error in Settings > Users when adding a user with "request bridge access" ticked and the bridge (off-the.cloud, the relay that makes devices reachable from outside the home) could not be asked whether the new user's address is free. {domain} is that address, such as kim.anna.off-the.cloud; {detail} is the reason, an error in English. "request bridge access" is the checkbox's label in the form: translate it as the label is translated.

dev.users.bridge_domain_limit.text: {domain} can't be added: your account on the bridge already holds as many addresses as it may - remove one on its account page, or uncheck "request bridge access" to create this user for your own network only
dev.users.bridge_domain_limit.note: Error in Settings > Users when adding a user with "request bridge access" ticked and the device's account on the bridge (off-the.cloud) already holds as many addresses as it may (the device's own and its users'). {domain} is the address the user would get, such as pepe.off-the.cloud. "request bridge access" is the checkbox's label in the form: translate it as the label is translated.

dev.users.confirm_mismatch.note: Error in Settings > Users when deleting a user: the username typed to confirm isn't that user's. Deleting a user removes all their files and data for good.

dev.users.name_taken_on_bridge.text: {domain} is already taken on the bridge - pick a different username, or uncheck "request bridge access" to create this user for your own network only
dev.users.name_taken_on_bridge.note: Error in Settings > Users when adding a user with "request bridge access" ticked and the address the user would get on the bridge (off-the.cloud) already belongs to someone else. {domain} is that address, such as kim.anna.off-the.cloud. "request bridge access" is the checkbox's label in the form: translate it as the label is translated.

dev.users.port_in_use.text: port {port} is already in use by another user
dev.users.port_in_use.note: Error in Settings > Users when adding a user with a port number another user already has. {port} is the number, such as 8082.

dev.users.stop_failed.note: Error in Settings > Users when deleting or disabling a user and the device could not stop that user's own copy of the software. {username} is the user's username (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens); {detail} is the reason, an error in English.

dev.users.storage_dir_failed.note: Error in Settings > Users when adding a user and the folder for their files could not be made on the device's disks. {detail} is the reason, an error in English.

dev.users.username_taken.note: Error in Settings > Users when adding a user with a username another user of this device already has.
